subject: general
question: A can do a certain work in 12 days and B can do in 18 days. They worked together for 4 days. The remaining work was completed by C alone in 6 days. If they get Rs. 3,240 for the whole work, then the share of C in this amount will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to do a certain work = 12 days

Time taken by B to do a certain work = 18 days

They worked together = 4 days

The remaining work was completed by C alone = 6 days

Total amount = Rs. 3,240

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12 and 18 is 36&
